tldr: DeepSeek priced agent web search at $0.75 per 1,000 calls on Oct 17, making search a metered line item. A long-horizon eval paper (Oct 26) and a 4-API community benchmark (Oct 27) followed.
whats_new: Cloudflare launched a beta Web Search API through AI Gateway, with unified logging, access controls and billing, via REST and Workers.
why_it_matters: Search is moving into the gateway layer where agent traffic is already logged and billed, so provider choice becomes a gateway config question, but the pricing and benchmark claims are still unverified.

status.detail: A second vendor now offers metered agent search, but sources are thin and the price point and benchmark are not independently confirmed.

beats.headline: DeepSeek prices agent web search at $0.75 per 1,000 calls
Community benchmark pits 4 search APIs against 30 live queries
Cloudflare adds a beta Web Search API to AI Gateway

open_questions: Do the benchmark's API rankings hold on a larger or different query set?
What does Cloudflare charge per call once the beta ends?
Do other search API vendors respond to DeepSeek's per-call price?
Is LongSearchEval adopted to compare search-agent systems?
take_for_builders: If you already route model traffic through a gateway, test its search option against your current API on your own production queries, tracking cost per 1,000 calls and answer quality before switching.
